versions.changelog: Note tweetedAt is UTC, prompt agents to convert to user local timezone
Added setup guide: prompt agent to help users sign up for RapidAPI key before first use

ai-news-feed 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Query real-time AI/ML news from 57+ curated Twitter/X accounts via REST API.
- Supports bilingual (EN/ZH) summaries, detailed analysis, importance scores, and topic tags.
- Endpoints include latest feed, trending posts, account-specific posts, tags, and health check.
- Provides filtering by tags, importance, account category, and supports pagination.
- Includes sample use cases for trending news, model releases, funding, and researcher tracking.
